caveats: This batch came from scraped directories largely without websites, and most records did not resolve to a live Google Business Profile. Six of ten are not verifiable as currently trading; only Progressive Automotive, A&C Tree Service and Gael Tree Service have hard evidence of current operation.

Status 'closed' for Crown Tree Service & Stump Grinding rests on two signals: the NJ Board of Tree Experts registry lists its licence as Suspended, and the Google Maps listing at its address is marked Permanently closed. A suspended licence is not in itself proof of closure, so this is an inference from the two together.

Google web search returned a CAPTCHA/bot check and DuckDuckGo returned a bot challenge, so confirmation relied on Google Maps place panels and on web_search results; Google review counts were often not rendered in the Maps limited view.
Gael Tree Service's USDOT registration showing 'registered since 2026' may reflect a recent re-registration rather than a brand-new company; that reading is an inference.
data_gaps: Google review counts for Progressive Automotive, A&C Tree Service and the closed Crown listing were not displayed, so review volume is unknown for those.
No robots.txt or schema.org checks were possible for these businesses because none of the ten has a website.
The Openbay shop page for Progressive Automotive returned HTTP 403, so whether online booking is actually enabled there is unverified.

A Google Maps listing named 'A&C Tree Service, C.H.E.A.P. Tree Service' (5.0, 1910 4th St, 732-548-1653) may or may not be the same firm as A&C Tree Service LLC licensed at 732-354-3788; phone numbers differ, so the match is unconfirmed.
Ownership, staff counts, years in business and revenue indicators are unpublished for all ten businesses.

Coyne Tree, Dedicated Tree Service, Thompson's Garage, Globe Auto Center and Brunswick Automotive Professionals could not be confirmed or disproved as operating; they are listed as not found rather than closed.
